title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #3

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Qul a'udhu" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Say: I seek refuge
   B. Say: I thank
   C. Say: I forgive
   D. Say: I worship

2. "Maliki yawmid-din" means (1 mark)
   A. Lord of all the worlds
   B. Master of the Day of Judgement
   C. Guide us to the path
   D. The Most Kind

3. What is a hadith? (1 mark)
   A. A chapter of the Qur'an
   B. A type of prayer
   C. A Muslim festival
   D. A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

4. When eating with others from one dish, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Reach across for the best piece
   B. Eat from your own side of the dish
   C. Take the whole dish
   D. Push others

5. What did the Prophet do if he did not like a food? (1 mark)
   A. Insulted the cook
   B. Left it quietly without criticising
   C. Threw it away
   D. Complained loudly

6. Who narrated the eating hadith from the syllabus? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Bukhari
   B. Ibn Majah
   C. Abu Lahab
   D. Al-Hakim

7. What should we say before brushing? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah
   B. Amin only
   C. Nothing
   D. Goodbye

8. Which of these is a benefit of exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Stronger muscles and a healthy heart
   B. Less sleep
   C. More diseases
   D. Weak bones

9. Which two names come from the word "rahmah"? (1 mark)
   A. As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   B. Ar-Rahman and Al-Malik
   C. Al-Malik and As-Salam
   D. Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim

10. Which name reminds us that Allah hears our dua? (1 mark)
   A. As-Sami'
   B. Al-Basir
   C. Ar-Rahman
   D. Al-Malik

11. What does "As-Salam" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Source of Peace
   B. The Most Merciful
   C. The All-Hearing
   D. The King

12. Which angel will blow the Trumpet? (1 mark)
   A. Israfil
   B. Jibril
   C. Atid
   D. Mikail

13. Who is called "Ar-Ruh al-Amin", the Trustworthy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Israfil
   B. Jibril
   C. Raqib
   D. Mikail

14. Sulaiman was the son of (1 mark)
   A. Nuh
   B. Ibrahim
   C. Yaqub
   D. Dawud

15. Which of these is NOT the correct way to treat a prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Worshipping the prophet
   B. Loving him
   C. Respecting him
   D. Following his good example

16. Which item may be used together with water in washing a heavy najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Paint
   B. Clean soil
   C. Sugar
   D. Salt

17. What should you do after cleaning a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore
   B. Sleep
   C. Eat immediately
   D. Wash your hands

18. Before which of these is wudhu required? (1 mark)
   A. Playing
   B. Prayer
   C. Eating
   D. Sleeping only

19. Which of these does NOT break wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Passing wind
   B. Urine
   C. Deep sleep lying down
   D. Eating and drinking

20. Which prayer is prayed at dawn? (1 mark)
   A. Fajr
   B. Asr
   C. Dhuhr
   D. Isha

21. In which direction does the sun rise? (1 mark)
   A. South
   B. North
   C. East
   D. West

22. What is a condition of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. A type of dua
   B. A part inside prayer
   C. Something needed before the prayer starts
   D. A festival

23. How many daily prayers are there? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Ten
   C. Seven
   D. Three

24. What is tuma'ninah? (1 mark)
   A. Loudness
   B. Speed
   C. Calmness in each position
   D. Ignoring order

25. What is a pillar (rukn) of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. A type of clothing
   B. A part that must be done for the prayer to be valid
   C. A place
   D. A drink

26. What is qiyam? (1 mark)
   A. Standing
   B. Bowing
   C. Prostration
   D. Sitting

27. Which is the correct order in one rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting, standing, bowing
   B. Ruku, Fatiha, sujud
   C. Sujud, ruku, Fatiha
   D. Fatiha, ruku, rising, sujud, sitting, sujud

28. Which is a Kenyan Muslim garment for men? (1 mark)
   A. Sari
   B. Buibui
   C. Hijab
   D. Kanzu

29. What should you do with a message saying school is closed if you are not sure? (1 mark)
   A. Check first
   B. Ignore parents
   C. Forward it at once
   D. Delete school

30. Why is it bad when children are made to beg? (1 mark)
   A. It helps them study
   B. They miss school and face danger
   C. They learn a lot
   D. It makes them strong

31. What should we say to family after entering? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. As-salamu alaykum
   C. Hello only
   D. Goodbye

32. What does Qur'an 66:6 tell believers? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore your family
   B. Protect yourselves and your families
   C. Travel far
   D. Sell everything

33. What does spending on family for Allah's pleasure count as? (1 mark)
   A. A sin
   B. Nothing
   C. Waste
   D. Charity

34. What does the hadith say about keeping family ties? (1 mark)
   A. It has no effect
   B. It reduces provision
   C. It causes trouble
   D. It increases provision and life

35. How can you keep in touch with a relative far away? (1 mark)
   A. Forget
   B. Ignore
   C. Insult
   D. Call, send a message or a gift

36. What is silat ar-rahm? (1 mark)
   A. Praying
   B. Fasting
   C. Keeping family ties
   D. Trading

37. Which is a way to apply the first verses? (1 mark)
   A. Skip reading
   B. Read and study daily
   C. Avoid school
   D. Ignore books

38. What does the command "Iqra" teach us? (1 mark)
   A. Seek knowledge
   B. Stay silent
   C. Only pray
   D. Avoid books

39. What is tolerance? (1 mark)
   A. Bearing with people who behave badly without hurting them
   B. Ignoring
   C. Insulting
   D. Fighting

40. What do we learn from the Taif journey? (1 mark)
   A. Be patient and merciful when hurt
   B. Give up
   C. Insult others
   D. Take revenge

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. List three rules for staying safe online. (3 marks)

42. Explain what Qur'an 17:23-24 teaches about treating parents. (3 marks)

43. Explain how Ibrahim and Ismail (A.S.) showed obedience to Allah. (4 marks)

44. What should a child do when two cousins quarrel? (3 marks)

45. Write the meaning of the first two verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (2 marks)

46. Give three benefits of the Islamic dress code. (3 marks)

47. Explain tuma'ninah and give the story that shows its importance. (3 marks)

48. Give three effects of belief in angels on a Muslim's life. (3 marks)

49. Describe how to clean a medium najasa on a mat. (3 marks)

50. Explain how physical fitness helps a Muslim in worship and in daily life. (4 marks)

51. State three evils of begging. (3 marks)

52. Describe how the Prophet (S.A.W.) solved the dispute over placing the Black Stone. (3 marks)

53. State the duties of Jibril, Mikail and Israfil. (3 marks)

54. State four features of the Islamic code of dressing. (4 marks)

55. Explain what a Muslim child should do before sharing a message. (4 marks)

56. Explain the hadith in which the mother is mentioned three times before the father. (3 marks)

57. Give three ways of thanking your parents for their care. (3 marks)

58. State three rules for using working animals safely. (3 marks)

59. Describe three Islamic manners to observe during games. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Say: I seek refuge
   Both protection surahs begin with these words.

2. B — Master of the Day of Judgement
   It is the fourth verse of Al-Fatiha.

3. D — A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   Hadith records what the Prophet said, did or approved.

4. B — Eat from your own side of the dish
   The hadith teaches eating from what is in front of you.

5. B — Left it quietly without criticising
   He never criticised food.

6. A — Al-Bukhari
   The syllabus gives Al-Bukhari.

7. A — Bismillah
   Bismillah is said before good acts.

8. A — Stronger muscles and a healthy heart
   Exercise strengthens the body.

9. D — Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   Rahmah means mercy.

10. A — As-Sami'
   As-Sami' hears whispers and silent prayers.

11. A — The Source of Peace
   As-Salam is free of all faults and gives peace.

12. A — Israfil
   Israfil blows the Trumpet by Allah's command.

13. B — Jibril
   This title refers to Jibril.

14. D — Dawud
   Sulaiman was the son of Dawud.

15. A — Worshipping the prophet
   We worship Allah alone.

16. B — Clean soil
   One of the washings uses soil.

17. D — Wash your hands
   Wash hands with soap and water.

18. B — Prayer
   Prayer needs wudhu.

19. D — Eating and drinking
   Eating does not break wudhu.

20. A — Fajr
   Fajr is at dawn.

21. C — East
   The sun rises in the east.

22. C — Something needed before the prayer starts
   Conditions come before the prayer begins.

23. A — Five
   There are five.

24. C — Calmness in each position
   Staying still for a moment.

25. B — A part that must be done for the prayer to be valid
   Leaving a pillar spoils the prayer.

26. A — Standing
   Qiyam means standing.

27. D — Fatiha, ruku, rising, sujud, sitting, sujud
   Tartib means this order.

28. D — Kanzu
   Kanzu is a long robe.

29. A — Check first
   Verify news.

30. B — They miss school and face danger
   Children should be protected.

31. B — As-salamu alaykum
   Greet with salaam.

32. B — Protect yourselves and your families
   Families need guidance.

33. D — Charity
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

34. D — It increases provision and life
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

35. D — Call, send a message or a gift
   Keep contact.

36. C — Keeping family ties
   Ties of kinship.

37. B — Read and study daily
   Apply the command to read.

38. A — Seek knowledge
   Islam values knowledge.

39. A — Bearing with people who behave badly without hurting them
   He did not curse them.

40. A — Be patient and merciful when hurt
   The Prophet's example.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Never share passwords or address, ask parents' permission, tell an adult about anything uncomfortable.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not say "uff", speak kindly, be humble and make dua for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three teachings.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice his son, Ismail said to do as commanded and that he would be patient, and both were ready. Allah replaced Ismail with a ram.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for Ismail's reply, 1 mark for readiness, 1 mark for the ram.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm, encourage them to forgive and make peace, and ask an elder if needed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for peace, 1 mark for asking elders.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Read in the name of your Lord who created; He created man from a clinging clot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, dignity and respect, trains modesty and self-control, obedience to Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each benefit.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tuma'ninah is staying still and calm in each position. The Prophet told a man who prayed hurriedly to go back and pray again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for the story, 1 mark for the lesson.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: More honesty, more thankfulness, respect for the Qur'an, remembering death and the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid effect.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove the substance, pour water until the colour, smell and taste have gone, then dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for removal, 1 mark for washing until traces go, 1 mark for drying.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: It makes prayer postures, fasting and walking to the mosque easier. It also gives strength for work and helping others.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for worship points and 2 marks for daily life points.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of dignity, laziness, wasted resources, lies, harm to children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: He placed the stone on a cloak and asked a leader from each tribe to hold an edge and lift it together, then he set it in place.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the cloak, 1 mark for leaders lifting together, 1 mark for setting it in place.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brings revelation, Mikail is in charge of rain and provision, Israfil will blow the Trumpet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Cover the awrah, loose and not see-through, clean and neat, not for showing off, no rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: Check whether it is true and kind, and useful and safe. If not sure, do not share, as Qur'an 49:6 says to verify news.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for true, 1 mark for kind, 1 mark for useful or safe, 1 mark for the verse or verifying.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: The mother deserves the best company because of her great hardship in carrying and raising the child. But the father must also be honoured.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for honouring both.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say thank you, make dua for them, obey in good, help at home, behave well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not overload, give water and rest, do not beat, keep them healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dress modestly, keep the times of prayer, avoid cheating and insults, respect others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each manner.
